concentration.hypothesis: Attention is concentrated on a few creators, so new and small creators' posts get zero engagement.
concentration.intervention: Surface first posts from new/small creators to likely engagers, as for the creators topic.
concentration.population: new and small creators on the scoped app

creators.hypothesis: New and small creators' first posts are not reaching likely engagers, so too many posts get zero engagement and creator supply softens.
creators.intervention: Surface first posts from new/small creators to likely engagers, and prompt a first reply on those posts.
creators.population: new and small creators on the scoped app

engagement.hypothesis: Feed/Reels relevance is soft for low-engagement segments, so engagement per impression falls without DAU falling.
engagement.intervention: Improve ranking relevance for low-engagement segments.
engagement.population: low-engagement users on the scoped app

growth.hypothesis: Activation after signup is weak, so DAU growth is not keeping up with signups.
growth.intervention: Improve signup-to-first-session activation for new users.
growth.population: new signups on the scoped app

messaging.hypothesis: Messaging is not becoming a habit for new users, so messaging DAU lags overall DAU.
messaging.intervention: Prompt a first message / reply in the first week, targeted at new users with no sent message yet.
messaging.population: new users on the scoped app with no sent message yet

retention.hypothesis: New cohorts are not forming a first-week habit, so D7 retention falls even while DAU is up.
retention.intervention: Improve first-week onboarding and re-engagement for new cohorts, with a clear first-week return prompt.
retention.population: new signups on the scoped app

concentration.label: Concentration — orphan rate and top-1% share
